---
title: "`ev_volcano_ring()` — volcano-in-ring composite"
---

## Purpose

Draw a single Cartesian figure with the volcano at the centre and the
enrichment results wrapped around it as an outer ring of NES-coloured arcs — one
panel that shows both the gene-level and pathway-level story for a contrast.

## When to use

The hero panel of the package. Use it when you want both the volcano and its
enrichment in one figure; compose several across contrasts with `ev_compose()`.

## How it works

No `coord_polar()` — everything lives in one `coord_fixed()` panel. The volcano
is rescaled into a disc of radius `volcano_radius`; significant points are
coloured up / down (others grey). Enrichment arcs are drawn with
`ggforce::geom_arc_bar()`: **up** pathways cluster at the top (90°), **down** at
the bottom (270°), ordered by FDR. Arc outer radius encodes $-\log_{10}(padj)$
(magnitude) and arc fill encodes NES on the diverging blue–white–red scale.
Per-gene radial ticks cross the grey track, coloured by each gene's logFC sign,
and leader lines connect arcs to cleaned pathway labels. Up/down counts are
boxed inside the disc. Returns an `enrichVolcano` object.

## Parameters & defaults

| Argument | Default | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `NULL` | defaults to blank; pass the contrast name |
| `subtitle`, `tag` | `NULL` | optional panel subtitle / corner tag |
| `volcano_radius` | `3.5` | inner volcano disc radius |
| `p_threshold` | `0.05` | significance cutoff for up/down calls |
| `logfc_threshold` | `0` | keep every significant point; raise to require effect size |
| `disc_color` | `NULL` | no tinted central disc unless set |
| `point_size`, `point_alpha` | `0.9`, `0.6` | legible without overplotting |
| `label_size` | `2.6` | pathway-label text size |
| `count_x_mult`, `count_y_mult` | `0.5`, `1.0` | count-box position in radius units |
| `label_mode` | `"none"` | volcano point labels off by default |
| `label_n` | `10` | cap for top-* label modes |
| `label_rank_by` | `"significance"` | rank labels by significance |
| `label_genes` | `NULL` | symbols for `label_mode = "explicit"` |
| `p_method` | `"pi_eq2"` | column for point colour and label selection |
| `theme` | `ev_theme()` | locked palette + theme |

## Literature

No method-specific citation; see [methods](../methods.qmd).

## Example

```r
e <- ev_enrich(dep, contrast = "CTLvMITO", databases = "reactome", species = "rat")
e <- ev_collapse(e)
ev_volcano_ring(dep[dep$contrast == "CTLvMITO", ], e, title = "CTL vs MITO")
```
